solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Very unfashionable French redhead is an intruder

parts.note: in French, très passé means very much out of fashion
the head, or first letter, of red is R

explanation.surface: A scornful remark about a ginger Frenchman's outdated look, who also turns out to be an intruder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French' tells you to put 'Very unfashionable' into French: TRÈS PASSÉ.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who goes onto land without permission is an intruder there.

clue.text: About a hundred remaining pull through

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as at the top of a business letter
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
over can mean left over, so remaining

explanation.surface: Something about a hundred people still hanging on and getting through.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull through an illness is to get better from it, a synonym.

clue.text: Apostle married in Israel

indicators.note: the married letter is put inside the word for Israel

parts.note: Sion is another spelling of Zion, a name for Israel or its people

explanation.surface: A disciple of Jesus who took a wife in the Holy Land.
explanation.definitionFit: Simon Peter, and also Simon the Zealot, were among the twelve apostles.

clue.text: One kills when crack troops go astray

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
the SAS, the Special Air Service, is the British Army's elite special forces regiment
to sin is to stray from the right path morally

explanation.surface: A killing happens when elite soldiers go off the rails.
explanation.definitionFit: A killer, especially a hired or political one, is called an assassin.

clue.text: Vile dreams still unsettled runner-up

indicators.note: unsettled means disturbed, so the letters of these three words are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who came second is troubled by nasty nightmares.
explanation.definitionFit: The runner-up in a contest, coming second, is awarded the silver medal.

clue.text: Soldier gets bowl of salad

parts.note: RA, the Royal Artillery, stands for a gunner or soldier
a dish is a bowl or shallow vessel

explanation.surface: A soldier is handed a bowl of salad in the mess.
explanation.definitionFit: This red root is a common raw salad vegetable, an example of salad fare.

clue.text: Diplomat about to get present

parts.note: HE is His Excellency, the title of an ambassador
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An ambassador is about to be given a gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' looks like a gift; it means in attendance.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone present is in attendance, at this place, a synonym.

clue.text: Man gets support packing in drug from now on

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man

indicators.note: the support beam holds the drug letter packed inside it

parts.note: a rafter is a beam supporting a roof
E is short for ecstasy

explanation.surface: A man takes a supporting role while giving up drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'packing in' looks like giving up the drug; here the beam packs E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means in future, after this time, a synonym.

clue.text: Cultivated a desire for cash

indicators.note: cultivated means worked over, like ploughed soil, so these letters are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone nurtured a longing for money.
explanation.definitionFit: This is British slang for ready money, banknotes on hand.

clue.text: Undesirables charge to take drug

indicators.note: the charge takes the drug letter inside it

parts.note: a sum is an amount charged
C is slang shorthand for cocaine

explanation.surface: Shady characters are charged with taking drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest, most worthless people are contemptuously called this, a collective synonym.

clue.text: Dressing a boy in Sunday best

indicators.note: the letters for a boy go inside those for Sunday best

parts.note: the cream is the best part
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A little boy is dressed up in his Sunday best clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dressing' and 'Sunday best' suggest clothes; the dressing is for salad.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a bottled British mayonnaise-style sauce poured on salads, so a kind of dressing.

clue.text: Engineer initially provides exhaust and fixtures

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of engineer

parts.note: to vent is to let out exhaust gases

explanation.surface: An engineer sees to exhaust pipes and fittings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fixtures' suggests fittings; here it means scheduled sporting matches.
explanation.definitionFit: Fixtures are arranged sporting occasions, so happenings on the calendar.

clue.text: Delighted the European Commission's unchanging

parts.note: EC is the abbreviation for the European Commission; the 's that follows reads as 'is', a link
static means not changing

explanation.surface: Someone is thrilled that EU policy is staying put.
explanation.definitionFit: To be overjoyed is to be delighted, a synonym.

clue.text: Charisma sadly is a thing of the past

indicators.note: sadly here means in a sorry, ruined state, so the letters of charisma are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lament that personal magnetism has unfortunately gone out of style.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned word or practice surviving from earlier times is a relic of the past.

clue.text: Husband gets experienced performers to show affection

parts.note: old hands are veterans skilled through long practice

explanation.surface: A husband brings in veteran actors to play a loving scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Couples clasp each other's fingers as a gesture of tenderness.

clue.text: Prove tenor is French

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for tenor in music
est is French for is

explanation.surface: Showing a singer to be from France.
explanation.definitionFit: To prove something can mean to try it out, as in 'the exception proves the rule'.

clue.text: Take off with list for engine part

parts.note: to fly is to take off into the air
a ship heels when it lists, leaning to one side

explanation.surface: A pilot departs with a checklist for a component of the engine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'list' suggests a written list; it is a ship leaning over.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy rotating disc that smooths an engine's running is a component of it.

clue.text: Rook upset wader

parts.note: R is the chess abbreviation for rook
to ail is to trouble or upset someone

explanation.surface: A rook, one bird, disturbs another that wades.
explanation.definitionFit: This marsh bird, such as the water variety, is a wading bird.

clue.text: Irate at badly-written song

indicators.note: badly written means set down wrongly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is cross about a poorly composed tune.
explanation.definitionFit: In opera, a short aria is a little song.

clue.text: Penny's crumbling spirits leading to melancholy

parts.note: D was the abbreviation for an old British penny, from the Latin denarius
something crumbling is old and decaying
rums are spirits, the drinks

explanation.surface: Penny's sagging mood is lifted by drinks that only lead to gloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a state of low spirits and inactivity is an idiom for gloom.

clue.text: Girl one takes on an assignment

parts.note: miss is a title for a girl
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A young woman accepts a task.
explanation.definitionFit: A task one is sent to carry out, a job or errand, is a synonym.

clue.text: Heartless humans showing integrity

indicators.note: heartless means losing the central letter

parts.note: mortals are human beings

explanation.surface: Callous people somehow displaying principles.
explanation.definitionFit: Principles of right conduct together amount to honesty and uprightness.

clue.text: Late sleeper puts own light off

indicators.note: off means gone wrong, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sleeping in turns off their own light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Late sleeper' sounds like a lie-in; it is someone who goes to bed late.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who stays up late into the night, sleeping late, is called this.

clue.text: Libyan leader enters game at the same time

indicators.note: the leader goes into the card game

parts.note: whist is a card game

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of Libyan

explanation.surface: A Libyan ruler joins a game simultaneously.
explanation.definitionFit: This conjunction means while, during the same period.

clue.text: Some said I omitted it, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: some of the words means a run of letters taken from inside them

explanation.surface: Someone says they left out a word, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed expression peculiar to a language is a way of saying something.

clue.text: The way an attorney's team give way

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
taken as written
DA is a district attorney in the US
a side is a team

explanation.surface: A lawyer's group yields on the route.
explanation.definitionFit: To step out of the way is to yield, a phrasal synonym.

clue.text: Irish leader twice gets the bird

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of Irish

parts.note: bis is Latin for twice, used in music for a repeat

explanation.surface: An Irish leader gets booed twice over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets the bird' is an idiom for being jeered at; here the bird is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: This long-billed wading creature is a bird, sacred in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Spoils of war

explanation.surface: Plunder taken in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spoils of war' reads as loot; split it into the verb 'spoils' and the war god.
explanation.definitionFit: To blemish is to spoil; and the Roman deity of battle bears this name.

clue.text: Paying for reconciliation

definitions.meaning: the payment of a bill or debt

explanation.surface: Paying money to make up a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a payment of what is owed and a resolution of a dispute go by this word.
